text_block_list.text:
It's the middle of summer and camp
season has
arrived!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The sun blazes over the campsite. Next
to it, at
the beach...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! Onward, my Opera O
opera troupe!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О's commands echo through
the air.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I am no longer by my lonesome, Trainer.
I have
gained capable followers from the
members of my
generation.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
They are Ayabe and Doto! These two
vanguards
will lead our advance.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Yes, this camp shall serve as the stage
for the
preliminary clash of generations!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: See? Lo, over yonder!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
S-Spe, cut that ooout... Stop splashing
me with
water.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I don't think so, Grass. Now stand
still,
please. ♪
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер and Спешл Уик, heroes
of the
older generation, are here at this
same camp.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
They are fierce, certainly—powerful
foes, most
definitely. But we will not fall!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Now, Ayabe and Doto! Arm yourselves
with
buckets of water that we may douse
those two till
they're drenched!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Hm... Ayabe? Doto? Where are you?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I don't see them anywhere, which
means...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What?! They've withdrawn themselves to
the
camping quarters?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Though, Doto did mention she felt
uncomfortable
in swimming attire...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
And Ayabe never responded to my
messages. I
assumed she was so adamant
about coming that
she wanted to reserve
her enthusiasm till we met.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Well then... It would appear we're
shorthanded.
The disadvantage is clear.
However...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
There is always hope! The most elite of
elites is
here beside me!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Now, onward! Onward, Trainer! You are
the last
piece afforded to me!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
We shall infiltrate and mercilessly douse
them
with sea water whilst chanting,
"Water the
flowers! Water the Grass!" ♪
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Dash...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Agh, Тренер?! Where do you think you
are off
to?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I get out of there as fast as my legs can
carry me.
Being at Opera O's mercy all
summer could be the
death of me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
